editorial:
Imagine having a best friend who knows everything about you, only for one bad mistake to turn your whole world upside down. You follow Zach and Josh, two teens who have been inseparable since they were kids. They are just normal guys hanging out until a freak accident happens that they cannot take back. Instead of doing the right thing, they decide to hide what happened. From that moment on, the movie stops being a story about friendship and becomes a stressful ride. You can feel the tension grow as their secret starts to eat away at them, turning their bond into something scary and toxic.

The acting here is what really makes it work because the lead actors make you feel their panic and anger. The pacing starts slow but picks up speed as the boys stop trusting each other and start acting out. While some parts might feel a bit too heavy, it is a great pick if you like stories about secrets gone wrong. It is the kind of movie that stays in your head long after the credits roll.
endingExplained: Everything falls apart when the friendship turns into a violent rivalry. Josh becomes completely unstable and tries to kill Zach. In the final struggle, Zach manages to fight back and kill Josh to save himself. The movie ends with Zach standing alone, having lost his best friend and his innocence. He is left to live with the guilt of the original accident and the fact that he had to kill his closest friend to survive.
targetAudience: Ideal for anyone who loves gritty stories about friendship and secrets.
